verdict.rationale: New Relic AI provides natural-language querying and troubleshooting assistance, and dedicated 'AI insights' features deliver AI-powered summaries of workload health, performance trends, and potential issues directly in the platform, with further automated remediation capabilities described. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the insight quality and no detail on how proactive/automatic (vs. on-demand) these AI-generated insights are.
